question: How do I work with trips?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Work With Trips
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how to work with trips

sections.title: Create a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to start a new trip that will later contain participants, items, todos, bags, comments, and other trip data.
items: Open the Dashboard, expand the Trip section, and click Trips.
Click the Add button with the plus icon. The Add Trip form opens.
Enter the trip name.
Choose the trip status if needed.
Enter the start date and end date.
Add notes if you want to save extra trip information.
Click Submit.
Plantour saves the trip, returns you to the Trips list, and highlights the new trip.
sections.afterHtml: After a trip is created, Plantour uses the selected trip as the main context for trip-specific pages such as Trip Participants, Trip Items, Trip Todos, Trip Bags, Itinerary, Activities, Expenses, Notes, and Comments.

sections.title: Select and review a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Selecting a trip is important because many pages in the Trip menu use the current trip as their working context.
items: Navigate to Trips via the Dashboard.
Click the trip you want to work with so it becomes highlighted.
Review the trip summary text in the list row, such as dates, participants, bags, and other trip details.
If needed, use filtering by Name or Trip Status and sorting by Name to narrow the list before selecting the trip.
After the trip is selected, open other pages from the Trip menu to work inside that trip.

sections.title: Update a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you need to change the trip name, dates, notes, or status.
items: Navigate to Trips via the Dashboard.
Select the trip you want to change so it is highlighted.
Click the Update button with the pencil icon. The Edit Trip form opens.
Change the fields you want to update.
Click Submit.
Plantour saves the updated trip and returns you to the trip list.

sections.title: Delete a trip
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to remove a trip and its trip-specific data from your account.
items: Navigate to Trips via the Dashboard.
Select the trip you want to remove so it is highlighted.
Click the Delete button with the trash icon.
Confirm the deletion.
Plantour removes the trip from the Trips list.
sections.afterHtml: Because the trip is the container for trip-specific data, deleting it removes access to that trip`s participants, items, todos, bags, comments, and related trip content.

sections.title: Download a trip PDF
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want a document version of the trip information.
items: Navigate to Trips via the Dashboard.
Select the trip you want to export so it is highlighted.
Open the page menu in the header.
Choose Download Trip PDF.
Plantour generates and downloads the trip report as a PDF file.

sections.title: Use the trip as your working context
sections.beforeHtml: Once a trip is selected, you usually continue into one of the trip-specific pages.
items: Navigate to Trips via the Dashboard and select the trip you want to work in.
Return to the Dashboard, expand the Trip section again,
and choose the next page you want to work with, such as Participants, Items, Todos, Bags, or Comments.
Work on that selected trip`s data there.
sections.afterHtml: This is the normal starting point for trip-specific workflows. For example, after selecting a trip you can continue with What can I do with trip items?.
